ns2:section.sectionText: The course content and instruction will be delivered using both the Compass course management system and Blackboard Collaborate/ Elluminate conferencing technology. There will also be weekly discussion sessions via virtual class in Blackboard Collaborate/Elluminate. Behavorial Science course. Topic: Children, Language and Communication ability. SECOND EIGHT WEEK CLASS. The Department does not wait list. **Please do not contact the instructor and asked to be added to the course if it is full. Continue to check online for openings.
